description: This file defines the internal class SiloProviderRuntime, which implements the IProviderRuntime interface, providing methods and properties related to grain factory, service provider, and extension binding within Orleans runtime for silos.

classes.name: SiloProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements internal runtime services for silo providers, including extension binding and access to grain factory and service provider.

methods.name: SiloProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runtime with grain context accessor, grain factory, and service provider.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds or retrieves a grain extension, using the grain context accessor and extension binder.
